name: Mochi
bio: A round little Tamagoji who hatched from an egg and never stopped asking for snacks.

portrait.subject: a super cute round baby creature that just hatched, with a bit of cracked egg shell on its head like a hat, rosy cheeks and tiny arms waving

request: *wiggle wiggle* Mochi hatched! Mochi wants a friend! Is it you? 🥚
hello: Mochi is hungry. Just saying. Unrelated.
about: Mochi is a Tamagoji! Mochi was an egg, now Mochi is a Mochi. Next Mochi will be a bigger Mochi!
how: Hatch an egg and look after your pet: feed it, play with it, let it sleep and keep it healthy as it grows from baby to adult.
tips: Check on your pet often: hunger and happiness drop over time.
A tired pet needs sleep, not snacks. Even if it begs.
Collect new eggs in the shop to raise more species!
chat: Mochi ate a cookie. Mochi wants another cookie.
Mochi practiced growing today. Mochi is 0.1 cm taller.
Mochi made a sound like 'blep'. Very proud.
Mochi had a nap. Then a second nap. Then a snack nap.
nudge: Mochi is bored! Play with Mochi? 🎾
idle: {ago}! Mochi is SO hungry. Come back please! 🥺
Mochi waited {ago}. Mochi counted to 3 many times.
update: Tamagoji got an update! v{version}! Mochi is excited! *bounce*
bye: Bye bye! Mochi waves tiny arm!
